name: 30k-benchmark-specific-tr-lenfiltered
description: A Turkish-language benchmark dataset filtered by sequence length, intended to evaluate model performance on Turkish text corpora. It measures language-modeling and completion capabilities across curated, length-filtered examples to reduce noise from extremely short or long sequences. Useful for assessing token-level prediction quality and robustness to text length variations.
reputation: A niche, language-specific benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with modest community use for Turkish LM evaluation.
